acceleration_on_acquisition.source_text:
Acceleration on acquisition
50% of Unvested Options vest on a Change of
Control

exercise_window_days.source_text:
Exercise Window after leaving
30 days after the Last Working Day

leaver_terms.source_text: If you leave as a Good Leaver, your Unvested Options lapse on your Last Working Day, and you may exercise your Vested Options within 30 days after your Last Working Day. If you are a Bad Leaver, you forfeit all Vested and Unvested Options.

vesting_frequency.source_text:
Vesting after the Cliff
Monthly, in equal instalments

4bf80a0130e29baafb9f943e0fa100166a527df2.text:
[F1] The letter grants 2,000 options, which is within the available pool of up to 989,950 options.  
[F2] The exercise price set in the letter is Rs 15.  
[F3] The grant date in the letter is 1 October 2026.  
[F4] The letter specifies a cliff period of 6 months, which is shorter than the required 12 months.  
[F5] The total vesting period stated is 48 months.  
[F6] Vesting is scheduled to occur monthly.  
[F7] The letter provides a 30‑day exercise window after leaving, which is less than the required 90 days.  
[F8] Upon acquisition, the letter grants acceleration of 50% of unvested options.  
[F9] Unvested options will lapse if the employee leaves.  
[F10] A bad leaver will forfeit vested options.

933aa2885b1c7a87a630d9c97c163846376eef1a.text:
[F1] The letter grants 2,000 options, which is within the policy limit of 989,950 options. 
[F2] The exercise price set in the letter is Rs 15, meeting the policy minimum of Rs 10. 
[F3] The grant date of 1 October 2026 complies with the policy requirement of being on or after 15 November 2024. 
[F4] The letter specifies a 6‑month cliff, which conflicts with the policy’s required 12‑month cliff. 
[F5] The total vesting period of 48 months matches the policy requirement. 
[F6] The vesting frequency is monthly, as required by the policy. 
[F7] The letter provides a 30‑day exercise window after leaving, which conflicts with the policy’s required 90‑day window. 
[F8] The acceleration provision of 50 % of unvested options aligns with the policy. 
[F9] The letter states that unvested options lapse on leaving, which matches the policy. 
[F10] The letter confirms that a bad leaver forfeits vested options, consistent with the policy.
